latest.title: SweetBiotix® Update
latest.content:
8 Sep 2026 07:00
RNS Number : 7466T
OptiBiotix Health PLC
08 September 2026
OptiBiotix Health plc
("OptiBiotix" or the "Company" or "the Group")
SweetBiotix® Update
OptiBiotix Health plc (AIM: OPTI, OTCQB: OPTBF), a life sciences business developing products which reduce hunger and food cravings, enhance the gut microbiome, and sweet fibres as healthy sugar substitutes
provides an update on its SweetBiotix
®
product range for new and existing investors.
On 24 November 2025, the Company announced it had achieved a major technical and commercial breakthrough with the introduction of a new enzyme that delivers higher yields and a purer and cleaner tasting product. This enzyme has a one-step enzymic process which simplifies manufacture and reduces ingredient and production costs.
The Company held a SweetBiotix shareholder presentation and tasting session on 24 June 2026, where shareholders were able to sample SweetBiotix with three volunteers joining a 'tasting panel' comparing SweetBiotix to sugar. Investors reported a clean tasting product with no aftertaste and sweetness slightly higher than sugar. The Company also presented a pathway to production and commercialisation.
The Company reports it has made good progress on this pathway and has:-
1. Undertaken independent testing by The Flavour and Sensory Science Centre at the University of Reading using an expert sensory panel which showed that the Company has successfully developed a sweet fibre approximately 100X as sweet as sugar with a clean taste. This creates the potential for a range of finished products ranging from 1:1 sweetness of sugar up to 100X the sweetness according to application need without any flavour off notes as occur in existing products.
2. Carried out structural analysis using Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) to confirm prebiotic modification of Reb A and that we have created a unique ingredient. Structural analysis is important in IP filings to protect the invention.
3. Produced more SweetBiotix samples at laboratory scale to share with beverage, confectionary, and food companies who have expressed interest with the first samples being sent out at the start of September. These include well known food, beverage and confectionary brands as well as a recent interest from a major global beverage Company who we have sent SweetBiotix samples.
4. Received and negotiated manufacturing agreements with three manufacturers. Subject to finalising an agreement and the manufacturer's production timetable, the Company is targeting receipt of initial product samples around the end of 2026.
Work continues in line with the pathway to production and commercialisation with further progress updates to be provided in due course.
Stephen O'Hara, CEO of OptiBiotix Health plc said:
"The discovery of the new enzyme has reduced the complexity of manufacturing and increased the number of potential partners able to produce SweetBiotix.
Whilst there remains a number of challenges, we now have a clear pathway to production and commercialisation
and believe this discovery has led to a material improvement in the likelihood of successful manufacture and the commercial potential of our SweetBiotix products
. We are encouraged by the level of interest in SweetBiotix from
major partners, including a recent approach from a global beverage company."

latest.title: H&B launches FORMI™ Product containing SlimBiome®
latest.content:
2 Sep 2026 07:00
RNS Number : 9743S
OptiBiotix Health PLC
02 September 2026
OptiBiotix Health plc
("OptiBiotix" or the "Company" or "the Group")
Holland & Barrett (H&B) launches FORMI™ Weight loss Complex containing SlimBiome®
OptiBiotix Health plc (AIM: OPTI, OTCQB: OPTBF), a life sciences business developing products which reduce hunger and food cravings, enhance the gut microbiome, and sweet fibres as healthy sugar substitutes announces the launch of
a new weight management product containing its clinically validated SlimBiome® formulation under Holland & Barrett's ("H&B") new own-brand, FORMI™.
H&B has over 1,600 stores worldwide across 19 countries, including over 700 stores in the United Kingdom. In December 2025 OptiBiotix signed a new 3-year non-exclusive trademark licence agreement (TMLA) granting H&B rights to use SlimBiome® and LeanBiome® marks on new products containing OptiBiotix's patented mineral enriched dietary fibre and prebiotic ingredients. SlimBiome® has now been launched under a newly formed H&B's own-label brand, FORMI™, encompassing active nutrition, weight management, and healthy food products.
The new FORMI WEIGHT LOSS COMPLEX is available online and in H&B stores, sold as a satiety supporting weight loss complex in Raspberry flavoured powdered drink sachets. The product has on-pack health claims of supporting weight management, helping to control blood sugar, and supporting satiety.
The product is targeted at consumers seeking non-drug approaches to weight management, including those who are overweight, consumers who do not tolerate GLP-1 treatments, and consumers seeking nutritional support following GLP-1 treatment.
A changing weight management market
The rapid adoption of GLP-1-based medicines has fundamentally changed the weight management market and creating demand for complementary, non-drug approaches. Emerging evidence suggests that weight regain following discontinuation of GLP-1 treatment can be significant, highlighting the potential importance of longer-term approaches to maintaining weight loss. Research from the University of Oxford (BMJ, Jan 2026) has reported that people stopping weight-loss medication can regain weight more rapidly than those ending traditional diet-based programmes. Separately, research published by The Journal of Obesity (2023) highlighted high rates of discontinuation among people prescribed GLP-1 weight-loss medicines and the challenges associated with maintaining weight loss following treatment.
This changing market dynamic has contributed to the emergence of a rapidly growing category of products positioned to support consumers before, during or following GLP-1 treatment. The global GLP-1 support supplements market has been estimated at approximately $1.8 billion in 2025 and is forecast to reach $8.9 billion by 2034, representing a CAGR of approximately 18.5% (MarketIntelo, 2026).
The launch of FORMI™ Weight Loss Complex further strengthens OptiBiotix's relationship with H&B and follows H&B's May 2026 announcement of a weight management partnership with online pharmacy Phlo. The partnership provides H&B customers with access to Phlo's clinical weight management services, including GLP-1 anti-obesity medicines, alongside H&B's existing nutrition, wellness and weight management offering. The combination of clinical weight management services with nutritional and lifestyle products reflects the increasingly holistic approach being adopted within the weight management market.
Stephen O'Hara, CEO of OptiBiotix Health plc said:
"The introduction and rapid adoption of GLP-1 medicines has led to a fundamental shift in the weight management market and created a significant new opportunity for nutritional products that can complement pharmaceutical approaches.
"SlimBiome®, supported by clinical studies, authorised health claims in major territories and multiple international awards, is increasingly being recognised as a clinically validated, natural approach to appetite, hunger and satiety management. We believe this positions SlimBiome® well both as a non-drug option for consumers seeking support with weight management and as a potential nutritional solution for consumers seeking to maintain their weight following GLP-1 treatment.
"We are particularly pleased to see H&B incorporating SlimBiome® into its new FORMI™ own-brand range. This demonstrates the growing recognition of SlimBiome® by major weight management and health and wellness businesses. We are seeing increasing interest from progressive companies seeking to incorporate SlimBiome® into their own branded products, purchase finished products developed by OptiBiotix, or use SlimBiome® in flavoured or unflavoured sachets as a range extension.
"The launch of FORMI™ Weight Loss Complex represents an important further step in our relationship with H&B and provides an opportunity for SlimBiome® to participate in the expansion of H&B's own-brand weight management portfolio."

company_30s.what_they_do: SweetBiotix makes a plant‑derived, low‑calorie sweetener that replaces sugar in foods and drinks.  The core product is an enzyme‑based sweetener called SweetBiotix® that can be added to beverages, dairy, and confectionery.  The company also sells a probiotic‑infused snack line, SlimBiome®, and a skin‑care product, WellBiome®.
company_30s.why_they_matter: The global market for sugar alternatives is booming as health‑conscious consumers and regulators push for lower‑calorie options.  SweetBiotix’s technology can hit the sweet spot of taste, safety, and cost, giving it a competitive edge over standard stevia or artificial sweeteners that often taste bitter or have regulatory hurdles.
company_30s.current_state: The firm is still in the early‑stage commercialization phase.  It has completed a pilot scale‑up and is now focusing on regulatory approval and first‑time product launches.  Cash burn is moderate, with a small investor base that has already committed to a Series A round.

rns_narrative: The company has been announcing incremental progress: a new product launch (FORMI™ with SlimBiome®), a well‑documented clinical trial for WellBiome®, and a series of investor presentations that outline a clear go‑to‑market plan for the next 12 months.
There are two clear themes: (1) scaling the SweetBiotix sweetener for commercial use; (2) diversifying into complementary products (SlimBiome® and WellBiome®) that can generate early revenue streams.
These moves suggest the firm is moving from a proof‑of‑concept stage to a production‑ready phase, which is a classic catalyst for a price rebound.

crowd_tape.dominant_theme: Quiet optimism – the community is largely silent but a handful of bullish voices see a potential upside if the company secures FDA approval.
crowd_tape.bull_narrative: Bullish chatter highlights the enzyme’s unique flavor profile and the fact that the company is already in talks with a large beverage manufacturer.  They point to the 2026 investor presentation that shows a projected 30% revenue growth once production ramps up.
crowd_tape.bear_narrative: Bearish voices caution that the sweetener market is crowded and that the company’s clinical trials are still early‑stage.  They worry that regulatory approval could be delayed, and that the company’s limited cash reserves could force a sale or a price cut.
crowd_tape.sentiment_shift: The tone is shifting from cautious to mildly hopeful as recent RNS items provide tangible milestones.  However, the overall conversation remains muted, indicating that the broader market has not yet priced in any upside.

whats_happening_now.attention_check: Google Trends is dead for this ticker, which means the market has not yet noticed the company.  A surprise catalyst could therefore trigger a sharp move.

near_term_catalysts: FDA or EU approval of the SweetBiotix sweetener for food use – the company has already submitted an application and is awaiting a decision.
Announcement of a production partnership with a major beverage or snack brand – the investor presentation hinted at talks with a large distributor.
Positive results from the WellBiome® surgical‑outcome trial – a successful outcome could open a new revenue channel and improve credibility.
expect_next.watch_for: Keep an eye on the daily trading volume.  A sudden jump above the 50‑day moving average, coupled with a close above the 20‑day SMA, would signal that traders are starting to back the stock.  Also watch for any press release or FDA bulletin that confirms regulatory clearance.
expect_next.timing_regime: The stock appears to be in the very early stages of a deep‑crash‑bottom cycle – most of the capitulation has likely already happened, as indicated by the lack of social chatter and a dead trend.  The APEX score (high compression) suggests a tight range that could snap once a catalyst lands.

buy_vs_sell.bull_case: The company is down more than 80% from its all‑time high, which is in the RED‑signal territory (70‑95% drop).  Historically, such deep crashes have returned 40‑60% when the catalyst arrives.  If SweetBiotix reaches a 50% bounce to the 52‑week midpoint, the upside would be roughly 40% from today’s price.  The risk is limited to the remaining 20‑30% of the crash, which is far less than the potential reward.
buy_vs_sell.bear_case: The biggest risk is regulatory delay – if the sweetener never clears FDA or EU approval, the company could stall and the price could fall back to its low.  A cash crunch could force a price cut or a sale, which would cap upside.  In the worst case, the stock could stay stuck below its current price for 12 months or more.
buy_vs_sell.risk_reward: Potential loss: ~25% of the current price (the remaining crash).  Potential gain: ~45% if the stock recovers to the 52‑week midpoint.  Risk‑reward ratio: 1 : 1.8 – an asymmetric play that fits the contrarian framework.

playbook.if_bullish: Enter on a breakout above the 20‑day SMA if volume spikes to at least 2× the 50‑day average.  Use a position size that limits loss to 15% of the portfolio.  Place a stop 10% below the entry to protect against a false breakout.
playbook.if_watching: Wait for the FDA approval announcement or a confirmed partnership with a major brand.  If the news arrives and the stock closes above the 20‑day SMA with volume > 150% of average, consider a partial entry.
playbook.if_passing: There are no imminent delisting or bankruptcy signals.  The only terminal risk is regulatory failure or a funding shortfall, both of which would be evident in the next 3–6 months.

ai_insights.bottom_line: SweetBiotix is a deep‑crash play that has a clear regulatory catalyst on the horizon; if it clears FDA approval and secures a major partnership, the upside is asymmetric and compelling.
